scenes.title: Types of Agents: Reactive & Goal-Based
scenes.voiceover_narration: Now let's talk about the three main types of agents. The first is the reactive agent. It responds to current input using predefined rules, with no memory or planning. Think of a simple Solara alert: if output drops below 8%, send a notification. Fast, predictable, but limited; it can't investigate why. The second type is the goal-based agent. This agent reasons about actions moving it closer to a defined outcome. It plans and evaluates options, choosing the path most likely to achieve its goal. Solara's Site Performance Investigation Agent works this way, deciding what data to pull based on what it finds to determine why a site under-performed.
